records.text: An unnamed law-enforcement source quoted in the article read by Owens said Kenneth “Kenny” Wynn, Steve Wynn’s brother, was the subject of an international child-pornography investigation. This reports an investigation, not a finding of guilt.
records.speaker: Wynn investigation law enforcement source (VUSs6CTp78Q; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Kenny Wynn (Kenneth Wynn), the brother of hotel casino developer Steve Wynn, is the subject of the same international child pornography investigation that netted another local man earlier this month, according to a law enforcement source with knowledge of the investigation.

conveyance.original_source: Unidentified 2004 article displayed as “Wynn Brothers subject in child porn probe”

records.text: The article’s unnamed law-enforcement source said Kenneth “Kenny” Wynn came under suspicion when Operation Predator investigators found his name on a website where child-pornography images were trafficked. The statement describes suspicion, not a conviction.
records.speaker: Wynn investigation law enforcement source (VUSs6CTp78Q; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Kenny Wynn (Kenneth Wynn), 50, came under suspicion when investigators taking part in Operation Predator discovered his name on a website where child porn images were trafficked, the source said.

conveyance.original_source: Unidentified 2004 article displayed as “Wynn Brothers subject in child porn probe”

records.text: The article’s unnamed law-enforcement source said authorities confiscated a computer from Kenneth “Kenny” Wynn’s home the previous week and were searching its hard drive for child-pornography images; the source did not say that images had been found.
records.speaker: Wynn investigation law enforcement source (VUSs6CTp78Q; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Authorities confiscated a computer from Kenny Wynn (Kenneth Wynn), Kenny Wynn (Kenneth Wynn)'s home, last week, and were searching its hard drive for images of child pornography, an involved process that could take some time, the source said.
